title: FS-Researcher: Test-Time Scaling for Long-Horizon Research Tasks with File-System-Based Agents
authors_zh: Chiwei Zhu、Benfeng Xu、Mingxuan Du、Shaohan Wang、Xiaorui Wang、Zhendong Mao、Yongdong Zhang
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理轨迹、反馈契约、选择机制与复现边界的读者
one_line: FS-Researcher preserves source archives and notes in a shared file-system workspace for long-horizon research.
FS-Researcher 把资料存档与笔记保存在共享的文件系统工作区中，以支撑长程研究任务。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）
why: It elevates durable workspace state to a Track 5 trace object.
inclusion_reason: Persistent workspace state is an inspectable long-horizon trace substrate.

title: Problem
问题
html: Deep-research agents must browse many pages, preserve fine-grained evidence, and write long reports. Keeping the entire trajectory in one model context forces observations, notes, and report drafts to compete for a fixed token budget; summarizing observations extends the run but can discard provenance and still remains context-bounded. FS-Researcher studies whether a persistent file-system workspace can externalize this state and support additional research sessions. The relevant data object is a task-linked workspace containing archived web pages, citation-grounded notes, plans, checklists, logs, and report sections—not only the final benchmark report.

深度研究智能体需要浏览大量网页、保留细粒度证据并撰写长报告。若把完整轨迹都放在模型上下文中，观察、笔记与报告草稿会争夺固定 token 预算；对观察进行摘要虽然能延长运行，却可能丢失血缘信息，并且仍受上下文长度限制。FS-Researcher 研究能否用持久文件系统工作区外置这些状态，并支持更多研究会话。相关数据对象不是单独的最终报告，而是与任务绑定、包含网页归档、带引用笔记、计划、检查表、日志和报告章节的工作区。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: FS-Researcher separates evidence accumulation from report composition. A Context Builder browses with search and page-reading tools, decomposes the topic, archives raw pages, and writes a hierarchical knowledge base whose claims point to archived sources. A Report Writer later reads that workspace on demand and drafts the report section by section. Markdown deliverables and control files—todos, a manually curated checklist, and execution logs—persist across sessions, so the file system acts as external memory and a coordination substrate. The control contract is environmental and checklist-based; the paper does not establish a learned per-action reward or an oracle process verifier.

FS-Researcher 将证据积累与报告撰写分离。Context Builder 使用搜索与网页读取工具，分解研究主题、归档原始页面，并撰写分层知识库，其中每条陈述指向归档来源；Report Writer 随后按需读取工作区，逐章节生成报告。Markdown 交付物以及待办事项、人工制定的检查表和执行日志可跨会话保存，因此文件系统同时承担外部记忆与协作介质。其控制契约来自环境状态与检查表；论文没有建立学习得到的逐动作奖励，也没有 oracle 式过程 verifier。

title: Method
方法
html:
Each agent follows a ReAct loop and can inspect or edit workspace files through list, search, read, insert, delete, and replace operations; web collection uses Google SERP and Jina-based page reading. The workspace separates deliverables from control files. Context Builder maintains index.md, hierarchical notes under knowledge_base/, and raw pages under sources/; statements in notes carry citations to archived files. It updates the index and notes non-linearly while browsing, then reviews the workspace against a checklist at session end. Report Writer creates an outline and writes sections against the saved knowledge base rather than carrying all evidence in its active context.

The paper evaluates DeepResearch Bench (100 tasks across 22 fields), DeepConsult (103 mainly business/consulting queries), and a random 100-query BrowseComp subset. Context-building sessions are varied to study test-time scaling; exact workspace records depend on backbone, tools, live web state, and run settings. The official repository is linked and the ACL page says code and data are open-sourced, but this Card has not verified a complete immutable release of every evaluated task, web snapshot, workspace revision, rejected source, judge record, and replay configuration. Those fields remain unknown or incomplete.

每个 agent 采用 ReAct 循环，并通过目录列举、搜索、读取、插入、删除和替换等操作检查或编辑工作区；网页收集使用 Google SERP 与基于 Jina 的页面读取。工作区区分交付文件与控制文件。Context Builder 维护 index.md、knowledge_base/ 下的分层笔记和 sources/ 下的原始网页；笔记中的陈述通过引用指向归档文件。浏览期间，索引与笔记会非线性更新；会话结束时再按检查表审查工作区。Report Writer 先建立大纲，再依据保存的知识库逐章节写作，而不是把全部证据留在当前上下文中。

论文使用 DeepResearch Bench（22 个领域的 100 个任务）、DeepConsult（103 个以商业与咨询为主的查询）以及随机抽取的 100 道 BrowseComp 题目评测，并改变上下文构建会话数来分析测试时扩展。具体工作区记录会受到 backbone、工具、实时网页状态与运行设置影响。官方仓库已链接，ACL 页面也声明开放代码与数据；但本卡尚未验证是否存在覆盖全部评测任务、网页快照、工作区版本、被拒来源、judge 记录和重放配置的不可变完整发布，因此这些字段仍为 unknown 或不完整。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports report-quality and citation metrics on DeepResearch Bench, comparative judgments on DeepConsult, and answer accuracy on the verifiable BrowseComp subset. It also compares matched backbones, ablates the persistent workspace, dual-agent separation, and section-wise writing, and varies Context Builder rounds. More builder computation grows the knowledge base and is positively associated with several report-quality measures, while the case study also shows readability decreasing as evidence density increases. File I/O is reported as a negligible share of wall-clock time.

This evidence supports the system claim that persistent workspaces can change long-horizon search and writing behavior under the tested harnesses. It does not certify each archived page, note, citation, or report claim. Most open-ended scores use LLM-as-a-judge, the web is mutable, and a correlation between builder compute and report score is not record-level data-quality proof.

论文在 DeepResearch Bench 上报告报告质量与引用指标，在 DeepConsult 上使用比较式判断，并在可验证的 BrowseComp 子集上报告答案准确率。实验还在相同 backbone 下比较系统，消融持久工作区、双 agent 分工与逐章节写作，并改变 Context Builder 的轮次。更多构建计算通常扩大知识库，并与若干报告质量指标正相关；案例同时显示，证据密度提高时可读性可能下降。论文还报告文件 I/O 只占极小的墙钟时间。

这些证据支持“持久工作区会改变已测试 harness 下的长程搜索与写作行为”这一系统结论，但不能认证每个归档页面、笔记、引用或报告主张。开放式评测多数依赖 LLM-as-a-judge，网页状态会变化，而且构建计算与报告得分的相关性不是逐记录数据质量证明。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior deep-research systems use static pipelines, sub-agents, or observation summaries to manage context pressure, and coding agents already use file-system workspaces. FS-Researcher's distinctive integration is a two-stage research harness in which raw web evidence, structured notes, navigation indexes, todos, checklist findings, logs, and report sections are durable, revisitable trace objects shared across sessions. This makes workspace revisions and agent handoff auditable in principle. ReAct, web search, Markdown files, dual-agent decomposition, and section-wise generation are not individually new. The paper contributes an agent environment and scaling study, not a new process-label dataset or guaranteed evidence verifier.

既有深度研究系统使用静态流水线、子 agent 或观察摘要缓解上下文压力，代码 agent 也早已采用文件系统工作区。FS-Researcher 的区别在于把这些组件整合为两阶段研究 harness：原始网页证据、结构化笔记、导航索引、待办事项、检查结果、日志与报告章节都成为跨会话共享、可回看的持久轨迹对象，因而原则上可审计工作区版本和 agent 交接。ReAct、网页搜索、Markdown 文件、双 agent 分解与逐章节生成均不是单独的新技术。论文贡献的是 agent 环境与扩展研究，而不是新的过程标签数据集或有正确性保证的证据 verifier。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Persistence does not guarantee correctness. The Context Builder can archive irrelevant or incorrect pages, paraphrase them inaccurately, or attach a citation that does not support the note; checklist self-review can share the generator's blind spots. The Report Writer is constrained by what the workspace contains and may still synthesize unsupported claims. Live search results, page contents, Jina extraction, model versions, and external APIs can drift, complicating replay.

The open-ended benchmarks rely on judge models and the paper's scaling analysis is correlational across allocated sessions. More rounds may add redundant evidence and reduce readability. A complete audit needs task and split manifests, immutable page snapshots, prompts/instructions, tool and model revisions, seeds, every workspace revision, rejected sources, checklist outcomes, judge inputs/outputs, and licenses for benchmarks and web content. Availability and completeness of those record-level artifacts remain unknown unless verified from the release.

持久化不等于正确。Context Builder 可能归档无关或错误网页、错误转述内容，或给笔记附上并不支持陈述的引用；检查表式自审也可能继承生成器盲点。Report Writer 受工作区内容限制，仍可能综合出缺乏支持的主张。实时搜索结果、网页内容、Jina 抽取、模型版本和外部 API 都会变化，使重放更困难。

开放式基准依赖 judge 模型，论文的扩展分析也主要考察分配会话数与结果的相关性。更多轮次可能增加冗余证据并降低可读性。完整审计需要任务与划分清单、不可变网页快照、指令、工具和模型版本、随机种子、全部工作区修订、被拒来源、检查结果、judge 输入输出以及基准和网页内容许可证。除非从发布物逐项核验，否则这些记录级工件的可得性与完整性仍为 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
FS-Researcher is useful as a concrete schema for long-horizon agent traces. A reusable record should preserve task ID, session and agent identity, source URL and retrieval time, raw-page hash, note-to-source citation, file path, edit diff, task-list/checklist transition, tool call and observation, outline and report-section revision, model/tool versions, cost, and terminal decision. Such workspaces can support provenance audits, handoff analysis, recovery experiments, and studies of how additional context-building compute changes coverage.

Reuse should separate raw evidence, model-authored notes, control state, and final prose; none should be treated as ground truth without independent checking. The reported benchmark gains motivate the environment design but do not establish that released workspace records, if any, are clean or licensed for post-training.

FS-Researcher 为长程 agent 轨迹提供了具体记录模式。可复用记录应保留任务 ID、会话与 agent 身份、来源 URL 和获取时间、原始网页哈希、笔记到来源的引用、文件路径、编辑差异、待办/检查表状态变化、工具调用与观察、大纲和章节版本、模型/工具版本、成本与终止决策。这类工作区可用于血缘审计、交接分析、故障恢复实验，以及研究增加上下文构建计算如何改变信息覆盖。

复用时应区分原始证据、模型撰写笔记、控制状态与最终文本；未经独立检查，任何一类都不应被视为 ground truth。论文的基准提升说明环境设计值得研究，但不能证明公开工作区记录（若存在）天然洁净或具备后训练许可。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat raw pages, structured notes, control files, and final report sections as separate objects with explicit links.
  • Verify note-to-source entailment and retain page hashes and retrieval timestamps; a citation path alone is insufficient.
  • Compare scaling runs with matched backbones, web snapshots, tool versions, judge settings, and total cost.
  • Preserve todos, checklist findings, logs, rejected sources, and file diffs instead of exporting only the successful workspace.
  • Treat benchmark and judge improvements as system evidence, not certification of the archived evidence or generated report.

• 将原始网页、结构化笔记、控制文件和最终报告章节视为不同对象，并保留显式关联。
  • 核验笔记陈述是否得到来源支持，同时保存网页哈希与获取时间；仅有引用路径并不足够。
  • 比较扩展实验时应固定 backbone、网页快照、工具版本、judge 设置与总成本。
  • 保留待办事项、检查结果、日志、被拒来源和文件差异，不要只导出成功工作区。
  • 将基准与 judge 改进视为系统证据，而不是归档证据或生成报告的质量认证。
